questions.q: What does McConaughey mean by a greenlight?
a: A sign you can move forward, or one you create yourself
A contract offered by a movie studio
A lucky break that cannot be planned
A warning to change direction
questions.why: The overview says a greenlight can be a gift or a fresh start, and you can make your own.

questions.q: What two lessons did the beatings he received teach him?
a: Do not hate, and never say you can't
Work first and play later
Never trust anyone outside family
Always finish what you start
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the punishments taught him not to hate and never to say he cannot.

questions.q: What did his year in Australia teach him?
a: He needed structure and challenge in his life
He wanted to become a teacher there
He preferred small towns to cities
He should avoid long trips abroad
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the lonely exchange year made him look inward and crave structure.

questions.q: How did McConaughey get his part in Dazed and Confused?
a: He met a filmmaker at a hotel bar and hit it off
He auditioned after a casting call at UT
His agent sent in a video reel
A professor recommended him to a director
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes meeting Don Phillips over drinks and being offered a role.

questions.q: Why did he stop taking romantic comedies?
a: He wanted a different challenge and a more meaningful life
Studios had stopped offering him those roles
He wanted to spend all his time on his ranch
His agent advised him to change genres
questions.why: Lesson 3 says he took a career risk to find more meaning, and was out of work for two years.
